hook: Tattoo shop owners: 3 questions about your *paperwork*
title: Tattoo shop *paperwork* quiz

questions.q: The shop license is framed by the front desk. Good forever?
options: No, it has a renewal date
questions.why: Shop licenses renew on a schedule. The frame doesn't.

questions.q: A guest artist is booked for December. What do you check first?
questions.why: Many areas require each artist to hold current credentials.

questions.q: Your bloodborne pathogens training was in 2023. Still current?
questions.why: These certifications often need renewing. Look at the date.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.

cta.title: Ink is permanent. *Licenses* aren't.
cta.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
